senses.gloss:
मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, stupefied, bewildered, per-
plexed, confounded, confused [cf. दिङ्-म्˚], uncer-
tain how to act; infatuated; stupid, dull, silly, foolish,
simple, ignorant; mistaken, deceived, erring, gone
astray or adrift; wrong, out of the right place (as
the fetus in delivery), abortive; causing confusion,
confounding; epithet of a particular position in the
Yoga system; (अस्), m. a fool, blockhead, dolt, idiot;
a sluggard; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the elements
in the Sāṅkhya philosophy.
—मूढ-गर्भ, अस्,
m. difficult delivery; a dead fetus.
—मूढ-
ग्राह, अस्, m. a confused notion, misconception,
infatuation.
—मूढ-चक्षुर्-गद-च्छेतृ, ता, m.
the remover of the defect of vision of the foolish.
—मूढ-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, or मूढ-चेतस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, bewildered in mind, foolish, simple, silly.
—मूढ-ता, f. or मूढ-त्व, अम्, n. stupidity,
infatuation, bewilderment, confusion, simplicity, folly,
ignorance; error, mistake, (ग्रन्थि-मूढता, mis-
take or confusion in disentangling a knot.)
—मूढ-
धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, or मूढ-बुद्धि, or मूढ-मति,
इस्, इस्, इ, ‘silly-minded, ’ silly, simple, foolish.
—मू-
ढ-प्रभु, उस्, m. the chief of fools, a great
blockhead.
—मूढ-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a man;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
—मूढ-वत्,
ind. like a fool.
—मूढ-सत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘silly-
minded,’ infatuated, insane.
—मूढात्मन् (˚ढ-
आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, bewildered or stupefied in mind, un-
conscious, insensible, foolish, a fool.
—मूढेश्वर
(˚ढ-ईश्˚), अस्, m. the greatest of fools, a great sim-
pleton, arrant blockhead; N. of an ascetic.
